verdict.rationale: Kling documents a RESTful API with JWT auth (AccessKey + SecretKey), global and China endpoints, and an MCP/CLI path for agents, all in a machine-readable llms.txt. That makes submitting a generation from docs plausible. A per-unit USD price table lets an agent estimate cost, and failed generations are not charged. However, nothing in the pack documents job-status polling or callbacks, asset download URLs, or per-job cost or credit reporting from the API, so most of the loop is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented task-status/polling endpoint, asset retrieval endpoint, per-job cost/credit reporting via API, request/response schemas, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent run.
